name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 10 – Am 98
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 10a. Notes that the report entitled ‘[Frères musulmans et islamisme politique en France’](https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/sites/minint/files/medias/documents/2025-05/2025-05-02-rapport-freres-musulmans.pdf) (Muslim Brotherhood and political Islamism in France), published by the French Ministry of the Interior in May 2025, is largely based on the statements of self-proclaimed experts whose work has been repeatedly criticised for a lack of methodological rigour and for advancing unverified narratives ; underlines that several of these individuals were identified in a 2022 investigation by European Investigative Collaborations, following revelations by The New Yorker, as being connected to networks supported by anti-democratic foreign actors and involved in a coordinated campaign aimed at discrediting Muslim civil society organisations across Europe;
